<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant M peak, an M+1 peak at ~9 % of M (consistent with ~9–10 carbons), and a very small M+2 peak (~0.6 %) typical of the combined probability of two 13C atoms—the only element whose isotopic signature can be unambiguously recognized is carbon. No characteristic chlorine, bromine, or sulfur patterns are present.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
